name: Dalmia Bharat Limited
remarksWeb: *Pursuant to a Scheme of Amalgamation sanctioned under fast track merger route by the Regional Director, South Eastern Region vide Order dated April 28, 2026 and  which became operational from May 26, 2026 , Maj Textiles Private Limited (Transferor Company 1), Dalmia Renewables Energy Limited (Transferor Company 2), Dalmia Sugar Ventures Limited (Transferor Company 3) and Dalmia Solar Power Limited (Transferor Company 4) amalgamated with Rama Investment Company Private Limited (Transferee Company) (Scheme). Pursuant to the said Scheme, 12,90,773 equity shares of the Company held by Maj Textiles Private Limited (PAN: AALCM3688E) were transferred to Rama Investment Company Private Limited (PAN: AAACR5350F).
shareholdingPatternNotes: 1.  All the Significant Beneficial Owners (SBOs acting together with each other hold indirectly through eleven (11) members [company(ies), HUF(s), trust(s)] and together with their direct holding(s) an aggregate of 55.84% of shares / voting rights in Dalmia Bharat Limited (the Company) by virtue of exercise of control pursuant to informal understanding amongst themselves.
